scratch/design.md item 19 is accepted: the launch pass keeps no private memory. It decides only from stored experiment state and the launcher run records that etude runs/status show; delete the eval pass's _Ledger (launched.json) if in-flight matches can be read from launched eval runs' job configs, else record why and add none for training; each pass reports its decision per run or tournament, and launch --quote shows the same without launching.
